about.title: About
about.subtitle: Atlas Munich is a community guide built to reduce the friction of arriving in Munich — especially for Moroccan students navigating bureaucracy, housing, and daily life.

manifesto.title: A guide that feels like a friend
manifesto.description: We focus on practical steps, real experiences, and small details that make Munich easier to navigate.

story.title: Why We Built This
story.p1: Moving to Munich as a Moroccan student or professional can be overwhelming. The bureaucracy is complex, finding housing is challenging, and figuring out where to find halal food takes time.
story.p2Start: Atlas Munich was born from this experience.
story.p2End: We wanted to create a single, trusted resource that answers all the questions newcomers have — the same questions we once had.
story.p3: Today, Atlas Munich is a growing collection of guides, tips, and resources maintained by volunteers who have been through it all and want to help others do the same.

values.title: Our Values
values.communityFirstDesc: Built by Moroccans in Munich, for Moroccans in Munich. Every piece of advice comes from real experience.
values.accuracyMattersDesc: We verify information regularly and update guides to reflect the latest processes and requirements.
values.openAndFreeDesc: All content is free and open source. We believe knowledge should be accessible to everyone.

community.guidelinesSubtitle: A few simple rules to ensure our community stays helpful, respectful, and valuable for everyone.

guidelines.respectful: Be respectful and kind. We're all here to help each other succeed in Munich.
guidelines.helpful: Share knowledge generously. Your experience could save someone hours of frustration.
guidelines.language: Feel free to use English, French, Arabic, Darija, or German — we're multilingual!
guidelines.spam: No spam, advertising, or self-promotion without permission from moderators.
guidelines.privacy: Respect privacy. Don't share personal information or screenshots without consent.
